annotations.title: Compose a workflow in a session

description: Authors the workflow in an open session beyond a recording: named API functions (define_function with a `flow`, preferred in an API build, or a captured call's index or a lists payload; live-tested as defined; compile_function for an authenticated request), set_inputs, add_steps, test_function, remove_function, remove_step, list. A flow is built in small calls: define_function with its first request, then add_flow_step {function, step, at?} per step, each tested and answered with the step list; a set step's value is read as {ref:'vars.<name>'}. Shapes: writ_help('writ_browser_compose').

operation.description: The action; add_flow_step, replace_flow_step and remove_flow_step change one step of a function's flow.

payload.description: The operation's arguments; add_flow_step: {function, step, at?}, remove_flow_step: {function, at}.

name: writ_browser_compose
